usage: assay [-h]
             {start,stop,version,doctor,status,view,act,commit,reset,python,channel,model,module,goal,export,spend,audit,approve,waive} ...

ASSAY referee harness: look, predict, act, compare

positional arguments:
  {start,stop,version,doctor,status,view,act,commit,reset,python,channel,model,module,goal,export,spend,audit,approve,waive}
    start               start or resume the one persistent run
    stop                stop this run's environment owner (the daemon)
                        cleanly; `assay start` resumes the run later
    version             the harness version, the journal spec it writes, the
                        interpreter
    doctor              check the interpreter, dependencies, anchors, socket
                        path, run state, daemon, adapter and registry; works
                        with or without a run here
    status              full picture: progress, image, actions, recent
                        results, notes
    view                inspect one event: the observation, the delta since
                        the previous one, history
    act                 take one action with a prediction; the result is
                        graded against it
    commit              run a prediction-checked batch or a model plan; halts
                        on the first miss
    reset               pay one action to rewind the current progress unit
    python              run offline Python with the history, deltas, BFS and
                        A* preloaded
    channel             declare and list registered channels (named readings)
    model               the general world-model tier: replay-fit is trust; fit
                        models earn batching
    module              behavior modules: list the active set, install one
                        (owner)
    goal                the standing goal: propose revisions (agent), ratify
                        (owner)
    export              export this run's earned knowledge for a future import
    spend               the external spend feed (the kernel cannot see the LLM
                        bill)
    audit               recompute journal integrity: chain, anchors, ungated
                        events
    approve             owner: grant one use of an approval-gated action
    waive               owner: waive a live actuator's rehearsal quota
                        (journaled)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
act:
usage: assay act [-h] [--predict PREDICT] [--because BECAUSE] [--at AT_EVENT]
                 [--declare "field=value"]
                 action

positional arguments:
  action

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --predict PREDICT     what this action does, e.g. "change; ch counter delta
                        = 1" (see below); required unless the registry sets
                        gate: optional
  --because BECAUSE     short reason for choosing this action
  --at AT_EVENT
  --declare "field=value"
                        structural declaration a gate or module demanded (e.g.
                        --declare "worst_case=..." --declare "recovery=...")

PREDICTION CLAIMS | separate several with ";"
  noop                 no observed change
  change               the observation changes (free text means this too)
  level+1              this action completes the current progress unit
  win                  this action reaches the goal state
  verify:PATH.py       run your verifier file: def verify(before, after) -> (ok, actual)
  ch NAME = V [± TOL]  a registered channel reads V after this action
  ch NAME delta OP V   the channel moves by an amount where OP is =, >=, <=
  ch NAME delta sign +|-    the channel moves up / down
  ch NAME crosses V [from below|from above]   the channel crosses a threshold
Any claim may end with `@within Ns`; it only grades if the result settles in time.
Channels: `goal` and `level` are built in; declare your own with `assay channel declare`.
Free text that is not a claim is kept as commentary. Example:
  --predict "ch counter delta = 1; verify:checks/counter.py"

FRAME WORLDS ONLY (grid observations) | x=column y=row | recognized, not admitted in 1.2.0
  cell X,Y=V           cell at column X, row Y becomes hex color V
  move X,Y DX,DY       the object covering X,Y shifts by (DX,DY) and vacates its old cells
  vanish X,Y           every cell of the object covering X,Y stops being its color
  region X0:X1,Y0:Y1   all changes fall inside this half-open box, and something changes
Example:
  --predict "door opens; cell 12,5=0; region 10:14,3:8"

positional arguments:

                        characters with no whitespace, control characters or
                        path separators. A benchmark adapter may read it to
                        pick the instance

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

                        /path/file.py:factory
  --registry REGISTRY   JSON file registering the actions, their parameter
                        schemas and the action budget; required for a fresh
                        run, optional on resume (the pinned one is used)
  --mode {local,competition}
                        local simulator (default), or expiring remote
                        competition validation
  --import KNOWLEDGE.json
                        import a prior run's exported knowledge (lands
                        FOREIGN, demoted)
  --owner-token-file PATH
                        write the owner token to this file (mode 0600, outside
                        the run directory) instead of printing it;
                        ASSAY_OWNER_TOKEN_FILE does the same
